attchmntText: Marsons Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Marsons Limited board approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Revenue from operations was 9,655.44 lacs. Profit for the period was 1,330.55 lacs. Earnings per share was 0.77 rupees. The board declared a first interim dividend of 5 paise per equity share. This equals 5 percent on 17,21,00,000 shares. Payment is due on or before 13 December 2026. The record date is 20 November 2026. The company also filed the statement on deviation or variation for proceeds. The results were reviewed by auditors NKSJ & Associates.

attchmntText: Marsons Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Marsons Limited declared an interim dividend of Rs. 0.05 per fully paid-up equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The Board of Directors approved this declaration during its meeting held on November 13, 2026. The dividend represents 5% of the face value of Rs. 1 per share. Payment will be made on 17,21,00,000 equity shares. The record date for determining eligible shareholders is Friday, November 20, 2026. Shareholders whose names appear in the Register of Members as of this date are entitled to the dividend. The payment is scheduled to be completed on or before December 13, 2026. This announcement is filed with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. under SEBI Listing Regulations.
